questions.stem: The finding of a single umbilical artery on examination of the umbilical cord after delivery is:
questions.stemHtml: The finding of a single umbilical artery on examination of the umbilical cord after delivery is:

options.label: C
options.text: An indicator of considerably increased incidence of major malformation of the fetus.

options.label: D
options.text: Equally common in newborn of diabetic and no diabetic mothers.
